mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < 12-month moving average for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals stronger supply-side momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 12-month moving average for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals stronger labor market momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts index below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 12-month moving average for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for three consecutive months signals a high inflation environment that erodes real corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
